steps.note: Victoria recruited, Zero Day's share still live: Open it trusts her, she opens the door and sells the raid, goes down the stair (victoria_sold). The moral cost shows in the credits.

said: There's your door. I'm sorry. Zero Day still pays, and you don't.
I'll see myself down the stair. Don't follow me.
notSaid: Their share's dead, so they've nothing left to pay me with.

said: I told you not to follow me.
notSaid: Go on. It's open, and I'm still on your side.

said: VICTORIA STERLING: Sold the raid. Gone down the gallery stair.
